claims.evidence: Witness report shows a red-and-black stationary upright cycling/exercise bike with flywheel housing and handlebars consistent with a spinning-style fitness bike.

claims.claim: High-quality Spinning Fitness Bike designed for effective home...
claims.evidence: No readable brand/model or performance specs are visible in the provided witness photo description.
Witness report does not show purchase date, warranty card, or any timestamp; no wear indicators are described clearly enough to confirm age.

claims.claim: Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: Witness report notes no clear brand/model and does not include checks for rust, brake/gears condition, or originality; these are not visible/confirmed from the described photo.

risks.risk: Not fully working (resistance/gears/brakes may be faulty, pedaling may be rough, console/display may not function).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing: pedaling smoothly at multiple resistance levels, no grinding noise, and the console/display (if present) turning on and responding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly needing service (worst-case: resistance/brake issues or non-working console).

risks.risk: Hidden wear or damage (pedals/cranks/belt/chain condition, wobble, frame misalignment).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the drive system (belt/chain area) plus a clip showing the bike pedaled while someone lightly checks for wobble/side-to-side movement at the frame and crank.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown mechanical condition (worst-case: drive wear or wobble).

risks.risk: Rust/corrosion not visible in the single described shot (especially on underside, bolts, and contact points).
risks.proof: Photos of the underside/base frame, pedal areas, and any exposed metal joints/bolts in good lighting.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible corrosion/unknown cleanliness (worst-case: rust on base/fasteners).

risks.risk: Seat/handlebar adjustment issues (stuck rails, stripped adjustment points, limited range).
risks.proof: A clip showing seat height adjustment and handlebar adjustment moving through range, then locking securely.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown adjustability (worst-case: adjustment not smooth or not locking).

risks.risk: Wrong or unclear model/brand (capacity and compatibility unknown).
risks.proof: A clear photo of any label/serial/model plate and the user manual/spec sticker (including max user weight).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown capacity (worst-case: lower capacity than expected).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of any brand/model/serial label and the spec sticker (including max user weight).
Send a short video showing the bike running: pedaling smoothly, resistance/gears changing correctly, and brakes stopping smoothly (no grinding).
Send close-ups of the drive system (belt/chain area) and pedal/crank condition.
Send photos of the underside/base frame and all exposed metal joints/bolts to confirm no rust.
Show seat and handlebar adjustments moving through range and locking firmly.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type (stationary upright cycling/spinning-style bike), so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. Seller claims about age, rust-free status, and perfect gears/brakes are not verifiable from the described photo alone, so pricing should assume unknown mechanical condition until the requested proof is provided.
